row.notes: Own pretty-function string 0x1456e3dfd 'GameDecalCustomisationSystem::flipEditorDecalNode(const VehicleDecalNode::Id&, const NEbool&, const NEbool&)'. If both flags p3/p4 false logs (CUSTOMISATION_DECALS) and returns. Else finds node id *p2 in p1+0x178..+0x180, copies its state to a stack copy, negates the scale vector +0x50 components for horizontal (p3) and/or vertical (p4) flip, and applies it with Game_GameDecalCustomisationSystem_ApplyEditorDecalState (0x14142e1ef). (lane owner review requested)
